text:
Asha (CEO): Morning all — quick weekly exec note and a few asks for the week ahead.
Luca (VP Product): Congrats on the Dedicated GA last week — solid start. main focus now: SLA, cost targets, and onboarding playbooks.
Maya (VP Eng): Building checklist for SLA telemetry done. Will push dashboards to Console by EOD Wednesday.
Asha (CEO): High-level priorities: 1) hit 99.9% region-level uptime for Dedicated; 2) reduce token unit cost by 12% MoM via batching/quantization; 3) finalize data-retention/legal language for Private.
Priya (Head of Ops): Ops items: rolling quota enforcement change goes live Tue 09:00 PT — customers on older plans will get a 7-day notice. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/quota-change (link restricted).
Jon (CTO): Quick incident summary from last Friday: routing fallback bug caused ~18m of increased p95 in us-west between 14:12–14:30. Root cause: stale model-variant mapping in the router cache. Fix: forced cache invalidation + added a short-circuit health check.
Maya (VP Eng): Postmortem draft up in #incidents, tl;dr: mitigations in place, adding automated cache invalidation on model rollouts and a canary window for 24h.
Asha (CEO): Metrics snapshot (week over week): p95 gen latency: 210ms -> 190ms; error rate: 0.45% -> 0.28%; avg cost per 1M tokens: $8.6 -> $7.7. Good progress but room to optimize.
Luca (VP Product): Product asks: 1) Marketing launch brief needs final stats by Thu noon. 2) SDK changelog and migration notes for Dedicated -> please tag me.
Priya (Head of Ops): Compliance/policy: updated retention defaults for Private deployments — 90 days logs by default, opt-in for extended retention. Legal approved the consent language.
Asha (CEO): People note: hiring update — two infra SREs start next Monday; ramp plan attached in HR doc. Please give them a warm welcome.
Asha (CEO): Asks for the leads: a 2-line status in thread on Monday AM: SLA blockers, estimated delta to cost target, and any customer escalations.
Luca (VP Product): Will post marketing numbers and the final launch banner by Thu.
Maya (VP Eng): SLA blockers: one outstanding perf regression test flake on sequence batching; ETA fix Wed.
deploy-bot: deploy/redwood-dedicated v1.0.3 succeeded — 1719012000 — rollout to us-west/ us-east. :rocket:
Asha (CEO): Thanks — will sync with the leadership team Friday. If anything urgent ping me or Priya. :thumbsup:
